transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I just feel wound up almost all the time. It's like my body is constantly... bracing for the next bad thing to happen. It doesn't really seem to matter what I'm doing, either. I could just be sitting at my desk working, or trying to enjoy dance night, and I still have that tense feeling.
About how long have you been feeling this wound-up and tense feeling?
I'd say it's been going on for about nine months now. It basically started right around the time the loan on my condo started moving toward foreclosure.
Is your worry mostly focused on the situation with your condo, or do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different everyday things?

It definitely started with the condo, but... no, it doesn't really stay on that anymore. It just jumps around to a lot of different things. Like, I'll find myself worrying about whether my cousin is upset with me, or... if I'm going to make a mistake on a support call at work. And then I'll just start stressing about how I'll ever save money or move forward with my life. So, yeah, it's pretty much just bouncing from one everyday thing to the next.
When these worries start bouncing around in your mind, how difficult is it for you to control or stop them?

It's really hard to stop them. Honestly, I can't really control it at all. Like, even when I tell myself I've already checked the spreadsheet at work, or I know I sent that email, the thoughts just keep looping. It's like one "what if" pops into my head, and then it turns into five more before I can even try to pull myself back. It just kind of spirals.
How has all this worry and tension been affecting your sleep?

It's been really affecting my sleep. Most nights I get into bed just completely exhausted, but... my brain won't turn off. I just keep replaying all the loan notices, or work tickets, or just worrying about things I might have missed. It usually keeps me up until 2 or 3 in the morning. And even when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested at all.
Have you noticed yourself feeling more irritable or easily annoyed lately?

Um, not really, no. I don't think I've been snapping at anyone or getting easily annoyed. I'm definitely exhausted, like I said, but the stress feels more like it's just happening inside my own head. So, yeah, I wouldn't say I've been irritable.
